_comment: Golden-trail regression suite — the pass/fail spine of System 3 (trailforge). Each entry encodes a FAILURE MODE our old extractors had, not just a famous hike. Coordinates are knowledge-seeded approximations: run `make verify-golden SNAP=1` on the homelab to snap each destination to its real OSM POI (osm_hint drives the match) before trusting reach tests. kind=destination → the assembled trail must reach `destination` within reach_tolerance_ft. kind=through → one trail object must connect both `endpoints` (tolerance endpoint_tolerance_mi). expected_one_way_mi is secondary (±length_tolerance_pct); reachability is the primary assertion.

trails.name: Devils Bridge Trail
trails.osm_hint: natural=arch named 'Devil's Bridge' (or the end node of Devils Bridge Trail #120); final approach is a rock staircase likely highway=steps
trails.why: THE regression. Systems 1/2 exclude highway=steps, shipping this trail 838 ft short of the bridge. Must assemble path+steps into one trail reaching the arch.

trails.name: Angels Landing Trail
trails.osm_hint: natural=peak 'Angels Landing'; final half-mile is the chained scramble (sac_scale, maybe highway=via_ferrata or path with safety tags)
trails.why: Chains-finish: exposed scramble section tagged differently from the approach trail must still be part of the trail object.

trails.name: Half Dome Trail (via Mist Trail)
trails.osm_hint: natural=peak 'Half Dome'; cables section is its own way (often highway=via_ferrata or path+safety=cable)
trails.why: Cables-finish + multi-named composition (Mist Trail -> John Muir Trail -> Half Dome Trail): tests both spur attachment and long name-transitions.

trails.name: Mist Trail to Vernal Fall
trails.osm_hint: waterway=waterfall 'Vernal Fall'; the Mist Trail's granite staircase section is plausibly highway=steps
trails.why: Waterfall destination + mid-trail staircase: steps must not BREAK a trail into two fragments.

trails.name: Delicate Arch Trail
trails.osm_hint: natural=arch 'Delicate Arch'; slickrock sections may be unnamed or trail_visibility=bad
trails.why: Arch destination over slickrock: segments with poor visibility/no name must still assemble.

trails.name: Quandary Peak Trail (East Ridge)
trails.osm_hint: natural=peak 'Quandary Peak' (14,265 ft)
trails.why: 14er standard route: above-treeline segments often sac_scale-tagged and patchily named.

trails.name: Diamond Head Summit Trail
trails.osm_hint: natural=peak / viewpoint on Lēʻahi (Diamond Head) crater rim; trail famously ends in two long staircases + tunnel
trails.why: Staircase-dominated finish (steps + tunnel): the extreme version of the Devils Bridge failure mode.

trails.name: Grouse Grind
trails.osm_hint: top station / chalet on Grouse Mountain; the Grind is essentially a 2,830-step staircase, plausibly highway=steps for long stretches
trails.why: A trail that IS mostly stairs — if steps are excluded, the whole trail vanishes.

trails.name: Sendero Base de las Torres
trails.osm_hint: viewpoint/lake at Mirador Base de las Torres; final moraine section may be unnamed/poor visibility
trails.why: Southern-hemisphere Spanish naming + unnamed boulder-field finish.

trails.name: Ben Nevis Mountain Track (Pony Track)
trails.osm_hint: natural=peak 'Ben Nevis' (1345 m); route may exist as a relation named 'Ben Nevis Mountain Track'
trails.why: Summit destination; UK naming ('Mountain Track' vs 'Pony Track' aliases) tests name normalization.

trails.name: Old Man of Storr path
trails.osm_hint: natural=rock / peak 'Old Man of Storr' pinnacle
trails.why: Destination is a rock feature, not a peak; upper paths often unnamed braids.

trails.name: West Highland Way
trails.osm_hint: relation type=route route=hiking name='West Highland Way' (Milngavie → Fort William), likely network=nwn
trails.why: Long-distance route relation must become ONE trail object end-to-end (relations-first assembly).

trails.name: Preikestolen (Pulpit Rock) trail
trails.osm_hint: tourism=viewpoint / natural=cliff 'Preikestolen'
trails.why: Norwegian naming + stone-staircase sections built by sherpas — likely steps segments mid-trail.

trails.name: Trolltunga trail
trails.osm_hint: natural=cliff / viewpoint 'Trolltunga'
trails.why: Very long day-hike; route pieces span multiple named ways and old funicular stairs at the start.

trails.name: Laugavegur
trails.osm_hint: relation type=route route=hiking name='Laugavegur' (Landmannalaugar → Þórsmörk)
trails.why: Sparse-OSM country + Icelandic characters (Þ, ö) — non-ASCII name handling end to end.

trails.name: Tongariro Alpine Crossing
trails.osm_hint: relation route=hiking 'Tongariro Alpine Crossing'; Emerald Lakes waypoint ~(-39.1340, 175.6530); descent from Red Crater is loose scree, possibly trail_visibility-tagged
trails.why: NZ marquee through-hike; volcanic terrain sections with degraded visibility tags must not fragment the crossing.

trails.name: Hooker Valley Track
trails.osm_hint: trail ends at Hooker Lake; track includes swing bridges (bridge=yes) and boardwalk (surface=wood) segments
trails.why: Bridge + boardwalk segments interleaved with path — structure tags must not break assembly. Also tests macron naming (Māori names).

trails.name: Queen Charlotte Track
trails.osm_hint: relation route=hiking 'Queen Charlotte Track' (Ship Cove → Anakiwa); may be a superrelation of stages
trails.why: Superrelation/staged route: stages must roll up into one trail object (the Te Araroa lesson).

trails.name: Mount Fuji Yoshida Trail
trails.osm_hint: natural=peak '富士山' (Mount Fuji); trail names primarily in Japanese (吉田ルート), name:en present on some ways only
trails.why: Non-Latin primary naming: assembly must group by the canonical name, not just name:en, and emit a displayable name.

trails.name: GR 20
trails.osm_hint: superrelation type=route route=hiking 'GR 20' composed of Nord/Sud (and stage) relations; osmc:symbol red/white
trails.why: The hardest relation case in Europe: nested superrelations + stages + variants must resolve to one canonical trail.
